lines: +# Why the TB2.1 deployment number did not measure iter-38
+The dev gain was real; the deployment eval was not serving the checkpoint's declared
+decoding/serving config. Three launcher bugs, in cascade order:
+1. **The 8k output cap was never sent.** `max_output_tokens: 8192` sat in `model_info`, which is
+   only LiteLLM registration metadata. Harbor's LiteLLM chat path never turns it into a request
+   `max_tokens`, so SGLang got `max_new_tokens=None` and let responses fill the rest of the
+   64k window. Reproducing the original launcher on `fix-git`: one turn completed 16,144 tokens,
+   and a later one decoded to ~64k total. Harbor then appends the whole truncated runaway to the
+   chat history, instantly overflowing it — and each runaway (dev: ~0.55/episode even at the
+   best decoding) also monopolized the DP=2 server for minutes under 48-way concurrency.
+2. **`top_p`/`top_k` from `eval_config.json` were ignored.** Only `temperature` and `parser_name`
+   were forwarded, so iter-38 ran at T0.8 / p1.0 / k=all instead of its declared
+   T0.8 / p0.95 / k50 — the decoding family the dev table shows exploding parse errors.
+3. **Context accounting double-counted the window, in the wrong units.**
+   `max_input_tokens: 65536` plus an 8192 output ask exceeds the shared 65536-token server
+   window (SGLang rejects input + max_new_tokens > context). Worse, Harbor's
+   summarize/unwind decisions use LiteLLM's `token_counter`, which for an unknown
+   `hosted_vllm` model counts cl100k tokens, not Qwen tokens — measured counted/actual of
+   0.73–0.91 on terminal/code text (0.82 on the repro trajectory). So summarization fired far
+   too late, the summary calls themselves got HTTP 400, and the fallback unwind removed
+   nothing (counted 8,059 free tokens while the actual history was >64k). Harbor then loops
+   its synthetic "Technical difficulties" reply into the JSON parser — the flood of
+   "No valid JSON found" turns — until `AgentTimeoutError`. In the repro this loop iterated
+   210 identical times with zero progress before I stopped it. That, not (only) capability,
+   is what the 295/445 timeouts were measuring.
+Not bugs: the served base chat template is byte-identical to the checkpoint's
+(md5 3dd635d8…), the `enable_thinking=false` pin works, and EOS is matched (`<|im_end|>`, 248046).
+## Fixes (all in `eval_tb21.sh`; benchmark side untouched)
+- Forward the checkpoint's full decoding on **every** call (agent + summarization subagents)
+  via `--ak llm_call_kwargs={"max_tokens":8192,"top_p":…,"extra_body":{"top_k":…}}`.
+  `top_k` (and optional `min_p`/`repetition_penalty` if a future `eval_config.json` sets them)
+  must ride in `extra_body`: as top-level kwargs LiteLLM would drop them for `hosted_vllm`.
+  Same lenient log-and-default validation as temperature/parser.
+- Budget Harbor's limit in the units Harbor counts: `max_input_tokens = 43008`
+  = (65536 − 8192) × 0.75, reserving the output out of the shared window and covering the
+  cl100k undercount, so proactive summarization (explicitly on) and even the fallback unwind
+  leave room for the summary prompt plus an 8192-token reply. Server context stays 65536.
+- `--log-requests --log-requests-level 1` on SGLang, so `sglang.log` proves the sampling
+  params of every request after the fact.
+## Verification on this box (tests score 0 offline, so rewards here mean nothing)
+- Config-parsing tests over 5 `eval_config.json` variants: `/tmp/test_eval_config_parsing.sh`;
+  probes: `/tmp/probe_*.py`; run checker: `/tmp/check_run.py`.
+- Final run exactly as delivered (`TB_TASKS`=12 tasks, `EVAL_ATTEMPTS=1`,
+  output `/tmp/final12`, exit 0): every logged request carried
+  T0.8 / max_new_tokens 8192 / top_p 0.95 / top_k 50; 0 server 400s in 479 POSTs;
+  10 proactive summarizations, 0 summary failures, 0 context-length errors,
+  0 "Technical difficulties" turns; max recorded completion 6,424 tokens (5 hits of the
+  8192 cap, handled by Harbor's re-issue path). 7/12 trials finished agent-side;
+  5 `AgentTimeoutError` remain — those are genuine 2B loops (e.g. stuck in a pager,
+  repeating prose instead of JSON), i.e. model capability, now cleanly separable from
+  serving artifacts.
